Conservative.description: High safety margin for cautious EVA traversal

Standard.description: Anchored to Perseverance traverse (>99% below 16 deg)

Extended.description: Extended capability up to 20 deg steep terrain

terrain_classes_ui.label: Difficult
terrain_classes_ui.meaning: Moderate slope, elevated energy & slip risk

risk_indicator_rules.Low: >= 90% of route length in Safe class AND max_slope <= 14 deg
risk_indicator_rules.Moderate: Not Low, with 0% of route in Forbidden class
risk_indicator_rules.High: > 30% of route length in Difficult class OR max_slope > hard_deg
risk_indicator_rules.disclaimer: Estimated preliminary route metrics; not certified for real-time navigation.
